dialogue.content: こんばんは。本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm looking forward to our session today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。こちらこそよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: なにか希望の設定はありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there a particular scenario you'd like to work with?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。おまかせしても良いですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. May I leave it up to you?

dialogue.content: わかりました！
dialogue.English: Understood!

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。ご相談して頂きありがとうございます。ご年齢と性別、どんなご相談か、お聞かせ願えますか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Thank you for reaching out. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 28歳 何もやる気が起きない
dialogue.English: 28 years old. I have no motivation to do anything.

dialogue.content: ご返信ありがとうございます。なるほど・・・いつ頃からやる気が起きなくなりましたか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. I see... About when did you start feeling this lack of motivation?

dialogue.content: 半年前からですら
dialogue.English: Since about half a year ago...

dialogue.content: です。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。半年間、そのことで悩んでこられたんですね。やる気が起きないと、モヤモヤしてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been struggling with this for six months. It must feel unsettling not to have any motivation, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: モヤモヤというよりこの先どうしていいのかわからなくて
dialogue.English: It's less about feeling unsettled and more that I don't know what to do from now on.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなんですね。それは不安を感じてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That makes sense. It's understandable that you'd feel anxious about that.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it does.

dialogue.content: やる気が起きない。無気力になってしまうことの原因として、どんなことが思い浮かびますか？
dialogue.English: This lack of motivation... this apathy. What do you think might be the cause of it?

dialogue.content: 今年入ってから同期が退職したのと部署異動と彼女と別れたのが短期間に重なったからかなと思います
dialogue.English: Since the start of this year, a coworker in my cohort resigned, I was transferred to a different department, and I broke up with my girlfriend—all in a short span. I think that might be why.

dialogue.content: そんなことがあったんですね。。立て続けにそんなことがあると、元気がなくなってしまうのは当然かと思います。
dialogue.English: I see—so all of that happened. When things like that happen one after another, it's completely understandable that you'd feel drained.

dialogue.content: とてもつらかったんではないかと思います。
dialogue.English: I imagine it must have been very painful.

dialogue.content: 辛いんですかね？
dialogue.English: Painful? I'm not sure.

dialogue.content: 私に同じことが起こったら、つらいかなと思うのですが、相談者様はどうお感じになってらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: If the same things happened to me, I think I would find it painful. But how do you feel about it?

dialogue.content: 分からないです
dialogue.English: I'm not sure.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。わからない。そんな気持ちなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Not knowing—that's how you're feeling right now.

dialogue.content: そんな感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, something like that.

dialogue.content: なるほど。ありがとうございます。あげてくださった3つの中で、一番心に残っている出来事はどれですか？差し支えなければ教えていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Thank you. Of the three things you mentioned, which one has stayed with you the most? If you don't mind sharing, could you please tell me?

dialogue.content: 比べられません。
dialogue.English: I can't compare them.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。どれも印象に残っているということですよね。
dialogue.English: That makes sense. It means they all left a strong impression on you.

dialogue.content: はい。すいません
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、とんでもないです。比べられないということは、それだけご本人にとって大きな事だからかと思います。では、あえて印象に残っていることを言葉にすると、どんな言葉が思い浮かびますか？
dialogue.English: No, no, not at all. The fact that you can't compare them probably means each one was a very significant event for you. If you had to try and put the impression they left into words, what words come to mind?

dialogue.content: 難しいですね。
dialogue.English: That's difficult.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。難しいかもしれません。色々な感情があったかと思いますので。
dialogue.English: It is, isn't it? It can be difficult, as I'm sure there were many different emotions involved.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今、将来の不安を感じておられるとおっしゃっていましたが、どんな不安が思い浮かびますか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that you're feeling anxious about the future. What specific anxieties come to mind?

dialogue.content: この先どうして行けばいいのか分からないです
dialogue.English: I don't know how I'm supposed to move forward from here.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。やる気が起きない状況だと、そう感じてしまうのも無理もないかと思います
dialogue.English: That's right. When you're feeling unmotivated, it's understandable to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 今現在は、勤務先でのお仕事に対してはどうしておられますか？何か問題はあったりしますか？
dialogue.English: How are things with your job at the moment? Are there any issues?

dialogue.content: 先月退職しました。身体がついていけなくて
dialogue.English: I quit last month. My body couldn't keep up.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうだったんですね。お身体は今はどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened. How are you feeling physically now?

dialogue.content: しんどいですよ
dialogue.English: I'm exhausted.

dialogue.content: そうですか。よほどご無理をなさっていたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You must have been pushing yourself very hard.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: I suppose that might be the case.

dialogue.content: それはやはり、同僚の方の退職や、部署異動の影響があったんですよね。
dialogue.English: And that was likely due to the impact of your colleague quitting and the department transfer, right?

dialogue.content: それも要因ですが人手不足で休日出勤と残業を続けていたら動けなくなりました。
dialogue.English: That was part of it, but because of a staff shortage, I kept working on weekends and doing overtime until I couldn't move anymore.

dialogue.content: それを会社に伝えたらじゃあ辞めてくれて構わないと言われ、退職した感じです
dialogue.English: When I told the company, they said, "Then you can just quit," so I ended up resigning.

dialogue.content: 情けないですよね。
dialogue.English: It's pathetic, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 他の人はそれでも働けているのに
dialogue.English: Even though everyone else is still able to work.

dialogue.content: そうですか、そんなことが。。
dialogue.English: I see—so that happened...

dialogue.content: 人手不足をまかなうために頑張ってきたのに、それはひどいですね・・・。
dialogue.English: You were working so hard to make up for the staff shortage, and for them to say that... that's awful.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか？会社にはお前の努力不足だと言われたのでそうだと思ってます。
dialogue.English: Is it? The company told me it was because I didn't try hard enough, so I thought that was true.

dialogue.content: そんなことを言われたんですね。私は情けないとは感じませんよ。人によって、耐えられる度合いは変わりますしね。相談者様は、頑張って耐えてらっしゃったんだと思います。
dialogue.English: They said that to you... I don't think it's pathetic at all. Everyone has different limits for what they can endure. I think you were enduring and trying your very best.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 休日出勤と残業を繰り返していたら、動けなくもなります。本当によく頑張ってらっしゃいましたね。
dialogue.English: If you're constantly working weekends and overtime, it's no wonder you reached a point where you couldn't move anymore. You truly worked very hard.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってるというより周りがみんなそうだったのでやるのが当たり前だと思ってました。
dialogue.English: It was less that I was trying hard, and more that everyone around me was doing it, so I thought it was normal.

dialogue.content: そうですか。私はそうは思えません。休み無く働くのはしんどいと感じるかと思いますよ彼女さんとの別れも、そのお仕事に原因があったりするのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. I don't see it that way. I believe working without breaks is exhausting. Your breakup with your girlfriend, was your work a factor in that as well?

dialogue.content: 最後の方は忙しくてあまり会えてなかったのでそう言われたらそうかもしれません
dialogue.English: Towards the end, I was so busy we couldn't see each other much, so now that you mention it, that might be true.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・。それは寂しかったかと思います。相談者様も、彼女さんも。
dialogue.English: I see... That must have been lonely. For both you and her.

dialogue.content: そうなんでしょうか。今となってはわからないです
dialogue.English: I wonder if that was the case. I don't know anymore.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。そうお感じになってらっしゃるのですものね。
dialogue.English: I understand. That is how you're feeling about it now, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 少し今までのことを整理させていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I summarized what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者様は、やる気が起きず、将来の不安を感じてらっしゃる。原因として考えられるのは、半年前から同僚の退職や部署異動での激務があり、休日出勤や残業が重なり、体調を壊したことが思い当たる。
dialogue.English: You're feeling a lack of motivation and anxiety about the future. As for the possible causes, you recall that starting six months ago, you had an intense workload due to a colleague quitting and a department transfer, which led to repeated weekend work and overtime, causing your health to decline.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 周りの人は同じように働いているのに、自分は動けなくなってしまったのが情けないと感じてらっしゃる。
dialogue.English: You feel it's pathetic that you couldn't move anymore, even though others around you were working just as hard.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 仕事が忙しすぎて彼女にも会えず、それが原因で別れてしまったこともあるが、もうそれについても辛かったとか思う感情のゆとりがない。
dialogue.English: You were too busy with work to see your girlfriend, which may have led to the breakup, but you no longer have the emotional space to even process whether that was painful.

dialogue.content: 退職しても今しんどい状況で、先行き不安を感じていらっしゃる。
dialogue.English: Even after resigning, you're still worn out and feeling uncertain about the future.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうすれば、相談者様は充実感ややる気を感じられると思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think would help you feel a sense of fulfillment or motivation?

dialogue.content: 分からないです
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。そうですよね。私が感じたことなのですが、お伝えしても良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. That makes sense. May I share my thoughts on what I've heard?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者様は、人手不足の中、休日出勤や残業を続けて、なんとか働いていましたが、ピンと張った糸が切れるように、疲れてしまったんだと思うのです。
dialogue.English: I think that you were managing to work amidst a staff shortage, continuing with weekend shifts and overtime, but then, like a tightly stretched string that snaps, you became completely exhausted.

dialogue.content: 周りの人は同じように頑張っていたとしても、人によってどこまで頑張れるかは違いますし、頑張れることが偉いことでもないかと思います。
dialogue.English: Even if others around you were working just as hard, everyone's breaking point is different, and I don't think being able to push harder makes someone superior.

dialogue.content: 感情がなくなってしまうくらい頑張られて、もう相談者様の頑張りは売り切れてしまったのではないでしょうか。。本当によく耐えてらっしゃったと思います。
dialogue.English: You pushed yourself so hard that your emotions went numb. Perhaps you've used up all your energy... I truly think you endured so much.

dialogue.content: 選択肢としては、一度体調が戻られるまで休むのも良いと思います。もしくは、働ける範囲の内容の仕事をするなどして、少しずつ慣らしていくこと。
dialogue.English: As for your options, I think it would be good to rest until you physically recover. Or, you could find a job with a manageable workload and gradually get back into the swing of things.

dialogue.content: ご自分では普通だと思ってらっしゃったかと思いますが、本当にご無理をされてたんだと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: You may have thought what you were doing was normal, but I believe you were truly pushing yourself too hard.

dialogue.content: 焦らず、少し休養するのも良いかと思いますが、どうお感じになられますか？
dialogue.English: I think it might be a good idea to take some time to rest without rushing. How do you feel about that?

dialogue.content: あまりピンと来ていません
dialogue.English: It doesn't really resonate with me.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。やはり、このままではいけないけど、やる気が出ない。。。という気持ちがあるのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I understand. Is it perhaps a feeling of, "I can't go on like this, but I just don't have the motivation..."?

dialogue.content: そうですね。このまま動けなかったらどうしようと不安です
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm anxious about what will happen if I can't get moving.

dialogue.content: 今は動けなくて不安を感じられるのも当然かと思いますが、きっと良くなります。すこしずつ気分も上がってくるかと思います。
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel anxious when you can't get yourself to do anything right now, but I'm sure things will get better. I believe your mood will gradually improve.

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね
dialogue.English: I wonder if that's so.

dialogue.content: はい。それまでは、無理せず休養されるのも良いかと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: Yes. Until then, I think it would be good to rest without pushing yourself.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: お時間過ぎてしまい申し訳有りません。他になにかお話したいことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I apologize for going over our time. Is there anything else you'd like to talk about?

dialogue.content: 今はありません
dialogue.English: Not at the moment.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談頂きありがとうございました。少しでも気持ちが楽になって頂けたなら幸いです。少しずつ良くなっていきますので、焦らず、できることをして下さいね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing with me today. I hope you feel even a little bit lighter. Things will get better step by step, so please don't rush and just do what you can.

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （終了します。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (We’ll end here. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました。勉強になりました
dialogue.English: (Thank you. This was a great learning experience.)
